mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tenant WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM tenant WHERE normalized_code = #{normalizedCode} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM tenant WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT plan_summary.current_plan_id AS currentPlanId, plan_summary.current_plan_code AS currentPlanCode, plan_summary.current_plan_name AS currentPlanName, domain_summary.primary_domain_id AS primaryDomainId, domain_summary.primary_domain AS primaryDomain, COALESCE(history_summary.status_history_count, 0) AS statusHistoryCount, history_summary.latest_status_change_type AS latestStatusChangeType, history_summary.latest_status_changed_at AS latestStatusChangedAt FROM tenant tenant_root LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tenant_plan.id AS current_plan_id, tenant_plan.code AS current_plan_code, tenant_plan.name AS current_plan_name FROM tenant_plan_assignment assignment JOIN tenant_plan tenant_plan ON tenant_plan.id = assignment.plan_id WHERE assignment.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND assignment.deleted_at IS NULL AND tenant_plan.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY assignment.assigned_at DESC NULLS LAST, assignment.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) plan_summary ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tenant_domain.id AS primary_domain_id, tenant_domain.domain AS primary_domain FROM tenant_domain tenant_domain WHERE tenant_domain.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tenant_domain.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN tenant_domain.is_primary THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, tenant_domain.id LIMIT 1 ) domain_summary ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS status_history_count, ( ARRAY_AGG(status_history.change_type ORDER BY status_history.changed_at DESC NULLS LAST, status_history.id DESC) )[1] AS latest_status_change_type, MAX(status_history.changed_at) AS latest_status_changed_at FROM tenant_status_history status_history WHERE status_history.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ) history_summary ON TRUE WHERE tenant_root.id = #{tenantId} AND tenant_root.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant SET code = #{code}, normalized_code = #{normalizedCode}, name = #{name}, status = #{status}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, provisioned_at = #{provisionedAt}, enabled_at = #{enabledAt}, disabled_at = #{disabledAt}, disabled_reason = #{disabledReason}, remark = #{remark}, created_by = #{createdBy}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, delete_reason = #{deleteReason}, deleted_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
